name: Pasiphae
axesStatus: Illustrative equal axes at the radius JPL Horizons lists; these are not three measured axes.
credit: JPL Horizons object data for Pasiphae (Jupiter VIII), revised 2025-May-12
shapeMeaning: Illustrative sphere at the 18 km radius JPL Horizons lists for Pasiphae. No shape model is published.
orientationMeaning: Illustrative ICRF north pole, arbitrary prime meridian and phase; no pole or rotation state is adopted.
surfaceMeaning: Unmapped surface: the standard grid is a coordinate aid, not observed colour or terrain.
introduction: Pasiphae is an outer, irregular moon of Jupiter, discovered in 1908. It follows a wide, tilted orbit far beyond the large moons.
card: An outer, irregular moon of Jupiter.
datasetSummary: A sphere at the 18 km radius JPL lists. Its shape, pole and rotation are not measured.
